meta.description: Apartments in the heart of Rome, transfers and experiences with Your Italian Holidays. Contact us to plan your stay.

hero.title: Ciao, I'm Brunilda.
hero.p1: I have been welcoming guests in Rome since 2012. With Your Italian Holidays I look after holiday apartments and help you plan your stay: transfers, tours, experiences and services on request.
hero.p2: I used to organise weddings and events. Today I bring the same attention to detail to welcoming guests, to make you feel at home and help you discover Rome.
hero.photoAlt: The founder of Your Italian Holidays

intro.p1: I have been welcoming guests in Rome since 2012. With Your Italian Holidays I help you choose the right apartment and plan your stay, from your airport arrival to the experiences you'll enjoy in the city.
intro.p2: Whether you're travelling as a couple, with family or with a group of friends, our base is in the centre of Rome, a short walk from the Trevi Fountain.
intro.signature: We look forward to seeing you in Rome

noah.description: Two bedrooms, each with a double bed, and a living room with a sofa bed. A single bed can be added on request. Ideal for families and small groups who want separate bedrooms and a central base for exploring Rome.
noah.facts: Up to 8 guests · 1st floor with lift

chloe.description: One bedroom with a double bed and a living room with a sofa bed, with a single bed available on request. A home for couples or families who want to stay in the heart of Rome, near the Trevi Fountain.
chloe.facts: Up to 5 guests · 1st floor with lift

luxury.description: One bedroom with a double bed and a living room with a sofa bed. The apartment looks onto the inner courtyard: a good choice if you prefer that kind of view while staying in a central spot near Trevi.

linda.description: One bedroom with a double bed and a living room with a sofa bed; a single bed can be added on request. A flexible option for couples and families, with one direct contact to organise your stay in the Trevi area.
linda.facts: Up to 5 guests · 2nd floor with lift

deluxe.description: Two bedrooms: one with a double bed and one with two single beds. The living room has two sofa beds. The apartment has one bathroom. The layout lets families and groups share the stay while keeping two separate bedrooms.
deluxe.facts: Up to 8 guests · 4th floor with lift

babuino72.description: Three bedrooms, each with a double bed, and a living room with a sofa bed. Ideal for families and groups who want several separate bedrooms on Via del Babuino, near Piazza di Spagna.
babuino72.facts: Up to 8 guests · 2nd floor with lift

babuino164.description: One bedroom with a double bed, two living rooms each with a double sofa bed, and one bathroom. Three rooms can be used for sleeping, with one separate bedroom. Located near Piazza di Spagna.
babuino164.facts: Up to 6 guests · 4th floor with lift

veneto.description: Five bedrooms, each with a double bed, three extra single beds and a living room with a sofa bed. The home has a kitchen and three full bathrooms. Air conditioning, windows onto Via Lombardia and a small balcony over the street. The building has a daytime concierge and automatic entry. Ideal for large families and groups who need several bedrooms and bathrooms, right next to Via Veneto.

barberini.description: One bedroom with a double bed, a living room with a sofa bed and a single bed, a kitchen and one bathroom. A home for couples and families on Via Emilia, in the Via Veneto and Barberini area.
barberini.facts: Up to 5 guests · 4th floor with lift

vatican.description: Two bedrooms, each with a double bed, and a sofa bed. Ideal for families and small groups who want two separate bedrooms in the Prati neighbourhood, with the Vatican close by.
vatican.facts: Up to 6 guests · 4th floor with lift

gabriella.description: One bedroom with a double bed and a living room with a sofa bed. Ideal for couples and families who want to stay on Via degli Ibernesi and enjoy the Monti neighbourhood.
gabriella.facts: Up to 4 guests · 1st floor with lift

maya.description: Two bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen, one bathroom and a small terrace. A home at Via dei Quattro Cantoni 6, in the Monti and Colosseum area, for guests who want separate rooms and some outdoor space. Contact us for the bed arrangement that best suits your group.
maya.facts: Up to 5 guests · 1st floor with lift

services.eyebrow: Tourist Station Trevi · Vicolo del Gallinaccio 7
services.title2: just the way you want it.
services.intro: Beyond holiday homes, we help you enjoy Rome and plan every moment of your trip. Our shop is your point of reference: we act as intermediaries to book transfers, tours, experiences and services with partner guides, drivers and operators. You tell us what you're looking for, and we help you find the right solution.

items.title: Holiday homes & management
items.text: Apartments for couples, families and groups, and full holiday-rental management for owners. Guest assistance, check-in coordination, key handover and collection, urgent cleaning and staff on request.

items.title: Private transfers & chauffeur service
items.text: We book transfers to and from Fiumicino, Ciampino and the cruise port, with private cars, minivans and luxury vehicles with driver. Door-to-door service, also for events and special occasions; requests at any hour, subject to availability.

items.title: Luggage storage & shower
items.text: Luggage storage at Tourist Station Trevi, Vicolo del Gallinaccio 7. On request, access to a private shower with clean towels and toiletries: a handy option before check-in or after check-out.

items.title: Private guided tours
items.text: We put you in touch with guides and operators to visit the Colosseum, the Vatican and the historic centre, choosing the route and experience that best suit your interests.

items.title: Day trips & boat tours
items.text: Through our partners we arrange excursions to Florence, Naples, Pompeii and the Amalfi Coast, plus boat tours in Rome, Amalfi and Capri. Itineraries and availability to be agreed.

items.title: Food, Vespa & nature
items.text: Wine tastings, cooking classes, Vespa or Fiat 500 tours, horseback rides and romantic dinners in the countryside. Tell us what you'd like: we'll find the right experience for you.

items.title: Events & special occasions
items.text: Help organising private events in Rome: birthdays, surprise parties, proposals, anniversaries, intimate weddings and romantic getaways. Tailor-made experiences for your special moments.

items.title: Tailor-made services
items.text: Photographers, babysitters and assistance for special needs during your stay. For any other experience or service, just ask: we'll check the options with our partners.

services.note: Services and experiences on request, subject to partner availability. We confirm prices and conditions before you book.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Useful information for planning your stay in Rome. Open a question to read the answer.
faq.help: For special requests, we're here to help.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is by 10:00. Let us know your arrival time so we can arrange your welcome and send you the access instructions for your apartment.

items.q: Can I leave my luggage before check-in or after check-out?
items.a: You can use our Tourist Station Trevi at Vicolo del Gallinaccio 7, open Monday to Saturday from 09:00 to 16:00. Contact us to check availability and the cost of luggage storage.

items.q: Can you arrange a transfer or experiences in Rome?
items.a: Yes, through our partners we can book private transfers, tours and experiences. Tell us what you need: we confirm availability, prices and conditions before you book.

items.q: How can I reach you during my stay?
items.a: For information and assistance you can call or message us on +39 347 809 1603. For emergencies during your stay, our number is +39 351 391 5959.

items.q: Where can I see where the apartments are?
items.a: Every listing has a “View on map” link. When you open “See the home and all photos” you'll also find the address and a button to show the map right in the apartment details.
